data.name: Spiritura
data.detailed_description:
Demo Available Now — Play 1–2 Hours of Spiritura

Explore a beautiful hand-drawn sandbox world filled with secrets and strange creatures. Master fast-paced combat and deep crafting in a colorful 2D adventure that lets you build, explore, and shape your own story.

A beautiful hand-drawn world

Journey through a lush forest, traverse treacherous snowy peaks, and delve into a mystical, glowing cave, and many more. Every corner of the world is a unique biome waiting to be discovered.

Master fast-paced combat with dynamic abilities

Face off against a variety of whimsical creatures. Use your sword for close-quarters combat or your magic spells for ranged attacks. Customize your build to fit your playstyle.

Meet unique characters and trade for valuable resources

The world is filled with friendly spirits and creatures who will aid you on your journey. Trade for powerful items, learn ancient lore, and unlock new abilities by helping those in need.

Take on powerful foes and claim epic loot

Challenge mighty bosses in your quest to save the world. Every victory brings you one step closer to your goal and rewards you with powerful gear.

Uncover ancient ruins and hidden pathways

The world is full of secrets to find and mysteries to solve. Use your platforming skills to reach new areas, discover hidden passages, and get lost in the magic of the world.

Build and customize your perfect home base

Create a sanctuary of your own. Gather resources to craft furniture, tools, and weapons to make your home a perfect reflection of your journey.

data.short_description: Spiritura is an atmospheric open-world survival crafting game with light RPG elements, exploration, and base building. Forge your own path through a mysterious, procedurally generated land, utilizing diverse combat skills to survive the threats of the wild as you uncover the secrets of the world.
data.supported_languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America

  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
